findings.reason: a worker dispatched from §52 would hold for a floor that has moved to another plan and for a condition the lead removed, and would report blocked against a gate no one owns.
findings.text: §52's `sib-full-dd-continuation` node is gated on "§51's cohort clears 100 of 143" and on "the catalog-consistency pass", but s51 is now descoped at 99 produced with that floor carried to sn-full-dd-continuation §2, and §52's own record `c-s52-carried-2026-11-11` records the lead's ruling of the same day that "the continuation run does not wait for the consistency pass"; the section therefore names a gate this plan can never satisfy and one the lead has retired

findings.reason: the section can be closed on its declared done-when without either run being measured, and a worker reads five nodes that no longer belong to it and none of the two that do.
findings.text: §52 stays `implementable`, and its record says it "stays open only for its two runs in flight, the documentation drain sib-docs-drain-after-admission and the batch sizing sib-consistency-batches", but neither run is a node in the section body and neither appears in its six done-when bullets, while the nodes the done-when does measure (census, cycle guard, cycle repair, catalog-consistency, continuation) have landed or been reassigned to sn-catalog-consistency and sn-full-dd-continuation

findings.reason: the remaining work is §52 alone and the cleared plan-blocks meta means no consumer reads the plan as gating that the release, so correcting the framing changes no node.
findings.text: s17's descope reason states "the WEST release this section waited on was retired", and the change clears plan-blocks to empty, while §1 is titled "Why it comes before the release" and the header still reads "S18, ahead of the WEST release" with an h1 of "The integrity backlog, fixed before the release"; sn-west-prototype-release confirms the retirement ("The lead retired the WEST-batch release on 2026-11-11"), so the plan's stated premise for its own ordering is contradicted by its own content

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every section the descope reasons cite resolves: sn-pipeline-hygiene §7, sn-catalog-consistency §6, §7 and §8, and sn-full-dd-continuation §2 all exist and each carries the rows its reason claims.
